scope: Research only: STACK Bossier Parish / Highway 3 Technology Park campus, Louisiana. Caddo/Blanchard and the later third Shreveport campus are not proposed additions in this handoff.

candidate.name: STACK Bossier Highway 3 Technology Park Campus
candidate.single_site_reason: One six-building development and supporting switchyard/infrastructure on a single named park. Neither each building, five plat lots, future lease area, excess land nor associated substation counts separately.

lifecycle.observation_date_method: Operator release dateline; publication-normalized current physical statement, not an independently reported inspection day.
lifecycle.finding: STACK explicitly reports construction already underway at its campuses in both Caddo and Bossier Parishes. Bossier is one identified component of that statement, not inferred from expenditure, job forecasts or the new community fund.
lifecycle.short_quote: With construction already underway at its planned campuses in Caddo and Bossier Parishes
lifecycle.body_anchor: Paragraph beginning STACK is putting its commitment to Northwest Louisiana into action
lifecycle.unselected: No finer construction phase, operating model, tenant role, workload, capacity or imagery observation is selected. September retrieval does not refresh June 10.

identity_bridge.finding: Parish reports March 18 approval of the Technology Park final plat for the Amazon campus and explicitly identifies STACK Infrastructure/AWS, over 1,000 acres, data-center buildings, substation and support structures.

identity_bridge.source_authority: Bossier Parish Police Jury proceedings published in the newspaper's legal/public-notice section, not the newspaper's separate reporter-authored article.
identity_bridge.finding: The proceedings name Highway 3 Technology Park, Benton MPC BP-8-26(SC), 1067.331 acres west of Highway 3 and north of Lone Oak Drive. STACK's representative states STACK and Amazon are both involved. The same Bohler applicant as the Corps notice presents six data-center buildings, with development confined to lots 3 and 4 and a switchyard on lot 3. Final approval is recorded.
identity_bridge.exact_site_binding: Sections 5, 6, 7 and 8, Township 20 North, Range 13 West; Section 32, Township 21 North, Range 13 West. Matching road, park name, applicant and six-building scope bind the Corps map to this campus.
identity_bridge.privacy: Residents' personal addresses, testimony unrelated to identity, signatures, and unrelated legal notices are not projected.

identity_bridge.finding: Corps application MVK-2025-00855 is for the west side of Highway 3 in Section 5, Township 20N, Range 13W. The attached maps explicitly name Highway 3 Technology Park; the six-building proposal matches the parish proceedings.
identity_bridge.scope_boundary: This permit application and its historical undisturbed-site statement are identity/geometry evidence only, not the selected construction observation or proof of permit issuance.

geometry_research.map_title: Site Location Map / Highway 3 Technology Park
geometry_research.source_geometry: Black dashed Project Site vector path inside the separately drawn red Site Boundary. The point is derived within the smaller project area, not from the full landholding, map viewport, parish or road centre.
geometry_research.source_crs: NAD83(2011) / Louisiana North (US survey feet), source embedded WKT matching EPSG:6477
geometry_research.derivation: Extract the 335-point black dashed vector path from page 5. Transform the four embedded geographic controls to the exact source projected WKT. Map normalized PDF positions bilinearly between those four projected controls, preserving the source's five-decimal control precision. Explicitly make_valid the self-touching project ring, then take its interior representative point in source projected units and transform to EPSG:4326. Suggested display tuple is rounded to five decimals and checked inside both project area and full site.
geometry_research.topology_caveat: The original Project Site path has a tiny self-touch at its road-access tip. It is preserved in the ignored derivation, not silently rewritten. Shapely make_valid produces a valid Polygon with one tiny hole and 330 exterior coordinates; area changes by -1.1175870895385742e-08 square feet (floating-point noise). The interior representative point is identical before and after normalization. Independent review must accept this derivation before admission.
geometry_research.full_site_scope_check: The independent red path is valid. Its derived area is 1066.689091350781 acres versus the map's 1065.95-acre label and later 1067.331-acre plat. No area-fitting is applied. The project's derived 234.13181603986382-acre footprint is a map area, not a surveyed lot area or observed current work extent. The 206.8-acre conceptual lease area on page 8 is not silently treated as the same polygon.
geometry_research.numerical_control_consistency: The maximum affine-fit residual implied by the four projected controls is 0.06092540027430425 metres. This checks numerical consistency only, not survey accuracy.
geometry_research.transformation: Inverse of SPCS83 Louisiana North zone (US survey foot) + NAD83(2011) to WGS 84 (1), axis order normalized
geometry_research.transformation_pipeline: proj=pipeline step proj=unitconvert xy_in=us-ft xy_out=m step inv proj=lcc lat_0=30.5 lon_0=-92.5 lat_1=32.6666666666667 lat_2=31.1666666666667 x_0=999999.99998984 y_0=0 ellps=GRS80 step proj=unitconvert xy_in=rad xy_out=deg
geometry_research.precision_caveat: Five-decimal control points and source vector-page precision limit reproduction. Additional calculated digits are computational precision only. The 2-metre datum-operation accuracy is not positional accuracy of the source drawing or locator. This point is not a surveyed building, entrance, boundary, parcel centroid or physical construction observation.
geometry_research.rejected_locator: The notice's literal latitude 32.753977 / longitude -93.736122 remains unselected because its narrative does not expressly identify the datum. The embedded map CRS is used for map-derived geometry only.
geometry_research.section_label_caveat: The map title prints Section 2, T21N, R13W whereas the parish proceedings identify Section 32, T21N, R13W. Preserve this discrepancy. The selected smaller project area and notice text are in Section 5, T20N, R13W, and the park/applicant/six-building/road identity bridge does not depend on correcting that northern title label.
geometry_research.format_context: Library of Congress geospatial-PDF format description explains the GEO measure dictionary, WKT source CRS and registration controls. The attempted original Adobe specification URL redirected to SDK-index HTML, so it is not asserted to be the normative specification.
geometry_research.calculation_libraries: pyproj 3.8.0 / PROJ 9.8.1; Shapely 2.1.2; bundled pypdf and pdfplumber
geometry_research.superseded_calculations: geometry-derivation.json incorrectly classified an off-page white dashed graphic; geometry-derivation-v2.json corrected classification but retained the invalid source project ring. Only v3 includes the explicit normalization audit. No release selected any of these versions.

duplicate_review.alias_search: Case-insensitive Bossier, Benton, STACK, Caddo and Highway 3 against every prior feature's full properties; no match.
duplicate_review.distance_method: All 187 full feature geometries tested for intersection; separation computed in candidate-centred WGS84 azimuthal equidistant CRS. Separation is not location accuracy.

successor_review.finding: Amazon's explicitly updated disclosure retains Caddo/Bossier and adds a third planned Shreveport campus, identifying STACK as developer/owner. It reports no completion or cancellation of Bossier. Its planned investment and future jobs do not replace the June 10 physical observation.
bounded_searches: site.stackinfra.com Louisiana completed operational cancelled August
successor_review.result: No authoritative actual completion/cancellation successor found through the August 20 cutoff. This is a bounded negative search, not an exhaustive permit or occupancy audit.

visual_review.method: Poppler full-page PNG rendering, no crops; newspaper page 12 additionally inspected at original 3600-pixel resolution.
visual_review.not_claimed: No site visit, satellite interpretation, current photograph date or independent imagery verification. Basemaps and concept drawings only establish location/scope.

rights.stack_rights_note: Release footer reserves all rights. Terms link returned 403 in web tool and was not bypassed.
rights.parish_rights_note: Parish-generated information is stated to be public domain with attribution appreciated. Outside materials and seals are excluded; no broader license inferred for attached proponent drawings.
rights.projection_policy: Distribute compact restated identity/status facts, source attribution, derivation metadata and a potential single locator only. Do not redistribute newspaper pages, Corps/proponent plans, HTML, photos, basemaps, logos, signatures or unrelated personal details. No blanket public-domain status inferred for third-party attachments.

capture_method: Credential-free single Node fetch per exact source, 30-second timeout, no overwrite and no retry. Successful responses stored as content-decoded bytes in ignored local custody.

raw_captures.response_kind: HTML redirect target, not PDF or normative specification; unselected

failed_capture.fallback: The independently published legal proceedings in the April 15 newspaper were captured successfully; not an access-control workaround.
